description: A modular, stack-agnostic toolkit for AI coding agents to autonomously find, reproduce, and patch vulnerabilities.

written.description: Reads a codebase and its commit history, builds a threat model from them, and sends agents to chase each hypothesis it raises. It then tries to reproduce each finding in a sandbox and attacks its own patch to check the fix holds, working from source alone with no running target.

alive.last_commit_message:
Refine MCP gate, call-edge resolution, and call-graph correlation

Addresses four gaps surfaced by live MCP dogfooding and cross-slice
correlation:

- MCP gate (`scripts/mcp_server.py`, `docs/mcp.md`): when a unified diff
  provides changed line numbers and a finding records its lines,
  `check_change` now distinguishes findings intersecting the modified
  hunks or enclosing functions (`relationship: "direct"`, which BLOCKs
  on HIGH/CRITICAL) from pre-existing findings elsewhere in the same
  file (`relationship: "unrelated_in_file"`, which raises REVIEW instead
  of BLOCK). Missing line information on either side fails closed to
  `"direct"`.
- MCP scan polling (`scripts/mcp_server.py`, `docs/mcp.md`):
  `mantis_scan_status` accepts `wait_seconds` (up to 60s) backed by a
  per-scan completion event so clients can long-poll instead of spinning
  on turns.
- Structural index (`core/structural_index.py`): `extract_unit` records
  the immediate static receiver qualifier on member calls, and
  `_resolve_callee_id` uses it both positively (to disambiguate
  same-named methods/functions by owning class or module stem) and
  negatively (refusing to link unmatched PascalCase class/model
  receivers like `UserModel.findAll` or ambient runtime objects like
  `console.log` to an unrelated class's method).
- Correlator (`core/correlator.py`): `correlate` grounds finding
  locations to their enclosing catalog symbols and emits
  `call_graph_edge` (`caller -> callee`) groups across files when the
  structural index is present; `generate_hypotheses` prioritizes
  confirmed defective symbols that have call sites inside `scan_item`
  and names the concrete `file:line` call sites in the lead rationale.
